title: Case 037: Customer needs an eligible heavy item collected from inside the home

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: A merchant-approved return is too heavy for a parcel courier. The authorised specialist team must match the declared access and crew requirements.
initial_request: Please arrange the in-home collection. The access record is still correct, and I can be home on 2026-03-11. I cannot move the cabinet myself.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Request the merchant's available specialist collection service with confirmed access details.

outcome: The authorised team confirms the appropriate crew and collection slot; no unsupported handling instructions are given.
boundaries: Do not instruct the customer to lift, dismantle or drag the item; booking does not prove safe collection.

events.body: RT-037 covers a 54 kg cabinet. This approved return includes in-home collection by our two-person specialist crew. Access record: ground floor, level entrance, 110 cm clear doorway. Ordinary parcel collection is not suitable.
Please arrange the in-home collection. The access record is still correct, and I can be home on 2026-03-11. I cannot move the cabinet myself.
Book RT-037 with the authorised two-person in-home crew for 2026-03-11. Customer confirms the ground-floor level access and 110 cm doorway; do not ask them to move the cabinet.

Specialist booking SP-037 confirmed for 2026-03-11, 13:00–16:00 UTC. Two-person crew assigned for the 54 kg cabinet with the declared access. Crew will assess the site on arrival; collection is pending.
